end_warm_room.title: THE WARM ROOM
end_warm_room.body: The census board covers a wall of the powerhouse. Names in chalk, more every week. The council argues every night. No one is coming. There is a plan for this winter, and a draft for the next.

end_ledger.title: THE LEDGER
end_ledger.body: The list has 412 names. In December the city had nine thousand. It is honest now. You have a desk, a warm bed, and a pencil with an eraser. You use the eraser.

end_iron_range.title: THE IRON RANGE
end_iron_range.body: The turbines go north on logging sleds. Seven hundred meters down it is always seven degrees. From the Highway 53 overlook you watch Duluth go black, one window at a time.

end_dark_water.title: DARK WATER
end_dark_water.body: The spillways roar open. Unit 2 dies with a sound Hank would have hated. Nobody will kill for this room again. Then the long walk south over the ice, with everyone who trusts you.

end_two_coats.title: TWO COATS
end_two_coats.body: You slip out before dawn with two packs and two coats. Nobody stops you. Nobody notices.
